flags.message: The provisioned 2026-10-05 as-stored snapshot ends with an August 14 proceeding and has internal creation date August 14, 2026. It extends a requested response to September 28, but contains no response filing or later distribution; the document manifest contains only petition/QP text fetched August 13. Apparent freshness/coverage gap: no inference of nonfiling, conference consideration, or denial was drawn. No current disposition was retrieved. Prediction uses the frozen one-distribution baseline and discounts the missing opposition.

The petition's hold request inconsistently describes the Town of Vinton companion petition as filed and forthcoming, citing application number 25-A1099. Companion filing status was not independently established; the forecast treats a lead-case hold/GVR as a possibility, not confirmed docket history.
